turns.text: I need the parcel for SC-2074 sent to a different address. I placed the order with nell.ashcombe@example.com.

The order SC-2074 has already shipped, and the address can only be changed before shipping. I've passed your request to a colleague, who will take over and tell you what is possible. Please have the new address ready.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Customer (nell.ashcombe@example.com) wants order SC-2074 delivered to a different address. Policy says address can change only before shipping; the order has already shipped. New address not yet given. Staff must decide.
